labels.cart_drawer_auto_open: Open drawer after adding to cart

info.colors_intro: Choose preset named schemes for the whole store, or one custom palette. Colours are never set per section.
info.colors_preset: There are five named schemes (sage, peach, dark, plus mist blue and soft lilac). Edit them below, then pick Store colour scheme for the site. Sections do not have their own colour scheme.
info.colors_custom: These colours apply site-wide. The preset scheme editor further down is ignored while Custom is selected.
info.typography_intro: Curated mode loads Google Fonts (preconnect + display=swap) into --cs-font-heading, --cs-font-body, and --cs-font-mono. Custom mode uses Shopify’s font_picker and @font-face (Shop fonts and Google in the library). Global colours are under Colors, not here.
info.typography_custom: Heading, body, and code use these fonts. They map to --cs-font-heading, --cs-font-body, and --cs-font-mono.
info.typography_preset_research: Three curated pairings: Neutral (versatile sans), Vision (Fraunces + Manrope: editorial serif + modern sans; Fira Code for mono), Technology (monospace headings + Inter body). To add or change a slug, update config/settings_schema.json, snippets/font-pairing-link.liquid, font-pairing-loader.liquid, snippets/css-variables.liquid, and src/styles/base/_fonts.scss. Keep href on fonts.googleapis.com.
info.search_scope: Product-only search uses Shopify’s type=product parameter. Articles and pages are excluded.
info.header_menu_nested: Add nested links in Online Store → Navigation (up to two levels under a top-level item). On large screens they appear as dropdowns and flyouts; in the mobile drawer they expand in place.
info.sticky_header: Controls whether the header stays visible when scrolling.
info.header_color_scheme_solid: The colour scheme used after the visitor scrolls past the hero, when the header has a solid background.
info.header_color_scheme_transparent: The colour scheme used at the top of the page while the header overlaps a hero section. Choose a light scheme for dark hero images, or a dark scheme for light ones.
info.logo_retina: Optional 2× version for sharp display on high-DPI screens. Upload at double the intended display size.
info.logo_width_retina: Display width of the logo. Upload your retina logo at twice this width in pixels.
info.logo_mobile: Shown on screens narrower than 768px. Falls back to the main logo if not set.
info.logo_mobile_retina: Optional 2× version of the mobile logo. Upload at double the intended mobile display size.
info.logo_mobile_width: Display width of the mobile logo.
info.desktop_header_layout: Large screens only. Phone and tablet still use the menu drawer and top bar.
info.size_guide_default_image: Shown in the size guide modal when a product has no `custom.size_guide` metafield. Upload a size chart (e.g. PNG or SVG).

font_pairing.neutral: Neutral — Plus Jakarta Sans + DM Sans (global)

desktop_header_layout.logo_nav_actions: Logo left — menu and cart/icons on the right
desktop_header_layout.logo_nav_center_actions: Logo left — menu centred — cart/icons right
desktop_header_layout.nav_logo_center_actions: Menu left — logo centred — cart/icons right
desktop_header_layout.two_row: Two rows — logo and cart/icons on top, menu below

header_top_bar.name: Top bar
header_top_bar.separator_info: Adds a vertical divider between items on desktop.
header_top_bar.rt_max_width_info: Set to 0 to use full available width.
header_top_bar.si_label_info: Text shown in the top bar. Hovering reveals the full details.
header_top_bar.color_accent_info: Used for focus rings and the subscribe button. Leave empty to inherit the theme accent.

blog.name: Blog
blog.hero_video_info: Upload a video. Overrides the hero image when set.
blog.animate_info: Items fade in with a stagger effect on page load.

info.overlay_softness: Adds a subtle background wash on the text side for legibility. 0% is off.
info.parallax_scroll: Background media moves slightly as the page scrolls (desktop only; disabled when reduced motion is on).

slide.name: Slide
slide.color_scheme_info: Optional. Falls back to the section scheme.
slide.background_media_info: Choose a still image or a video file hosted in your store.
slide.image_info: When using video, this image is the poster frame before playback (recommended).
slide.video_info: Shown when Background type is Video. Use an MP4 from Shopify Files.
slide.heading: Heading
slide.content_overlay_enable_info: Adds a colour layer between the background and text for better contrast.
slide.content_overlay_coverage_info: Text column only tints behind the copy. Full slide covers the entire hero.
slide.content_color_override_info: Applies to this slide’s eyebrow, heading, body, text links, and primary/secondary actions. The slide colour scheme still controls the overall palette when overrides are not set, or for anything these fields do not cover (e.g. focus rings use the scheme accent).
slide.content_color_link: Text link (body, heading links, and secondary action)
slide.content_color_btn_bg_info: Use a transparent or semi-transparent value for the outline look. Solid fills for a pill button.

main_product.name: Product
main_product.layout_info: Reorder blocks to change the product page; app blocks follow block order and temporarily close the product form so app markup is not nested inside it. Description, specs, and accordions use the **Product tabs** section.
main_product.size_guide_pdp_info: Optional size chart for this product template. When set, and the product has no `custom.size_guide` metafield, this image is used **instead of** the theme’s global size chart. Product metafield content still takes priority. Leave empty to use the global or metafield only.
main_product.size_guide_image_info: Overrides the global theme size chart for this product template when the product has no `custom.size_guide` metafield.

product_tabs.name: Product tabs
product_tabs.intro: Description tabs, rich text tabs, spec rows, and accordions apply to this product. App blocks stack below the tabbed area. Add this section below **Product** on the product template.
product_tabs.content_max_width_info: Maximum width of the tab content and app blocks inside this section (centered).
product_tabs.tab_description_heading_info: Leave blank to use the default label for this block type (see theme language → Products).
product_tabs.tab_rte_heading_info: Leave blank to use the default label for this block type (see theme language → Products).
product_tabs.tab_rte_include_specs_info: When enabled, every Spec row block in this section is rendered inside this tab.
product_tabs.tab_rte_empty_message_info: Optional. Shown when this tab has no rich text and no spec table content (when specs are included). Leave blank to use the theme default message.

footer.name: Footer
footer.tagline_info: Optional short line under the shop name.
footer.show_social: Show social icons when URLs are set
footer.copyright_note_info: Short text after the shop name (optional).
